name_zh: 整理書包與桌面
steps_zh: 清空不需要的紙屑收據、把文具與筆記本分層歸位、擦拭桌面恢復清爽。
steps_en: Discard receipts/wrappers, sort pens and notebooks, and wipe your desk clean.

name_zh: 畫一張靈感小卡
steps_zh: 拿出一張便條紙或小卡，隨筆塗鴉剛才上課聽到的關鍵詞或心情插畫。
steps_en: Take a note card and doodle a lecture concept, motivational quote, or mood sketch.

name_zh: 寫三句重點讀書筆記
steps_zh: 回顧上一堂課，用自己的話總結三個核心知識點，加深長期記憶。
steps_en: Summarize the 3 most crucial takeaways from the last class in your own words.

name_zh: 安靜讀兩頁課外書
steps_zh: 暫時放下手機螢幕，享受幾分鐘純粹的文字閱讀時光。
steps_en: Put away phone notifications and immerse yourself in 2 pages of a favorite book.

name_zh: 排好明日待辦與行事曆
steps_zh: 列出明天的作業期限與上課教室，標記最重要的三件優先事項。
steps_en: Review upcoming assignment deadlines and classrooms; flag top 3 priorities.

name_zh: 整理本機練習檔與下載區
steps_zh: 將桌面與 Downloads 資料夾的教材檔案分類歸入專案資料夾。
steps_en: Sort downloaded course slides and code exercises into dedicated project directories.

name_zh: 在校園合適走廊或中庭慢走
name_en: Take a gentle walk in courtyard
steps_zh: 暫離座位走到走廊或花園中庭，維持輕鬆步伐放鬆久坐的雙腿。
steps_en: Step outside to the courtyard or hall, stretch your legs at a comfortable walking pace.

name_zh: 觀察天空雲彩並畫速寫
steps_zh: 走到戶外抬頭觀察雲朵光影與微風，用速寫本記錄下此時的天氣氛圍。
steps_en: Look up at the cloud formations and lighting, jotting down quick shapes and impressions.

name_zh: 合適校園步道快走提神
name_en: Take a brisk walk across campus
steps_zh: 繞行學院大樓或操場外圍快走，加速血液循環掃除下午課間的睡意。
steps_en: Brisk walk around the building or athletic field to boost heart rate and banish drowsiness.

name_zh: 規劃小組期末專案大綱
steps_zh: 整理組內分工進度，擬定下次討論議題與待確認事項清單。
steps_en: Map out milestones for group coursework and outline agenda items for the next meeting.

name_zh: 探索並記錄校園自然色彩
steps_zh: 在校園草坪或林蔭步道尋找 3 種植物或花朵，拍下或記錄自然的色彩漸層。
steps_en: Stroll near campus greenery, spotting 3 distinct botanical colors or leaf textures.

name_zh: 構思下一次社團活動主題
steps_zh: 用便利貼進行腦力激盪，擬出社團迎新、聚會或工作坊的亮點提案。
steps_en: Mind-map creative ideas, interactive icebreakers, and themes for upcoming club events.

name_zh: 課桌椅肩頸深層伸展
steps_zh: 雙手抱頭向下緩慢拉伸頸後肌群，左右側彎拉伸斜方肌，各維持15秒鐘。
steps_en: Gently tilt head side-to-side, roll shoulders backward, and stretch tight neck muscles.

name_zh: 4-7-8 腹式呼吸減壓調息
steps_zh: 用鼻子吸氣4秒、屏息7秒、用嘴緩慢呼氣8秒，連續進行4個循環穩定自律神經。
steps_en: Inhale 4s, hold breath 7s, exhale slowly for 8s. Repeat 4 cycles to lower stress hormones.

name_zh: 補水與遠眺綠色護眼
steps_zh: 喝滿一杯溫水，走到窗邊注視6公尺外的遠景綠樹，讓睫狀肌徹底放鬆。
steps_en: Drink a full glass of water, then gaze at distance trees beyond 20 feet to relieve eye strain.

name_zh: 教學大樓爬樓梯微運動提神
steps_zh: 不搭電梯改爬2至3層樓梯，維持穩定呼吸，迅速喚醒下肢肌肉與大腦思緒。
steps_en: Skip the elevator and climb 2-3 flights of stairs at steady pace to boost circulation.

name_zh: 尋找校園未曾去過的秘密角落
steps_zh: 走平常沒走過的學院步道或圖書館背側小徑，發現校園新視角與安靜據點。
steps_en: Take an unfamiliar pathway behind another department building to discover peaceful spots.

name_zh: 閃卡抽考上課核心要點
steps_zh: 打開 Anki 或筆記軟體，進行 10 張核心專有名詞與概念的主動回憶（Active Recall）。
steps_en: Run through 10 digital flashcards to test recall on key terminology from previous lectures.

name_zh: 戴耳機享受沉浸放鬆音樂
steps_zh: 戴上降噪耳機，閉上雙眼聆聽三首無人聲 Lo-Fi 或大自然白噪音放鬆大腦。
steps_en: Put on headphones and close eyes for 3 ambient or Lo-Fi tracks to reset sensory overload.

name_zh: 傳訊息給同學互相關心加油
name_en: Send an encouraging text to a friend
steps_zh: 發一則溫暖的訊息給同系好友或室友，問問對方今天課堂順利與否。
steps_en: Drop a cheerful greeting or funny meme to a classmate or friend to stay connected.
